desc: Brewpub offering craft house brews & snacks in a space with plants & natural lighting.
addr: 523, 33rd Cross Rd, 4th T Block East, 4th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011, India

rev.t: Brew Meister is a fine place to hangout. I went to the terrace but found the setup to be a bit congested; guess they want to accommodate as many customers as possible. Smoking was allowed though there was a warning written. This place brews …
Food was below average, not too bad. Chicken loaded nachos was not fresh. Mushroom Cigar was good, beer was good. Place is very much under maintained …
Thought bit run down but you get beer😁nice and airy though .. needs some cleaning I guess …
